summary: Verified the new fair fixed-house-edge (RTP 0.90) upgrade model end-to-end on the live preview. Backend: 9/9 pytest checks pass (game-config values, server-side chance = bet/price*RTP, 83% bet cap, 1% min-chance, 600 real spins across 2 runs with win rate 0.433 and 0.427 vs expected 0.45 and ZERO forced_loss, protection doc = {rtp,bank,liabilities} with no 'player' key, pre-spin solvency refusal with no debit + cheap target still playable, admin settings only rtp_target, PUT rtp 0.85 reflected in /api/game-config then restored to 0.9, /api/admin/players rows have no 'cycle'/_id). Frontend: guest and logged-in chance gauge correct (x2 -> 45.00%, 75% -> 75.00% with bet 73.33 on Case #1 88), max slider does not trigger 'Ставка выше…', real spin completed (win, skin added to inventory, header balance 5000 -> 4926.67). Admin UI: bank banner shows 'Честная модель с фиксированной комиссией 10%', single RTP slider only, Players tab has no 'Судьба депозита' column. Full cleanup done: all qa_* docs deleted from users/upgrades/drops/presence/item_history/luck_cycles, bank untouched at 42000, rtp_target = 0.9.

Balance chip has no dedicated data-testid for its value (only data-testid="balance-button"); harder to assert balance updates

action_items: Update PlayersTab hint text (data-testid="players-hint") to describe the fair fixed-commission model instead of the removed 'судьба депозита'/drain/luck-cycle system
Optional: strip 'updated_at' from the settings payload returned by GET /api/admin/bank and PUT /api/admin/bank/settings
critical_code_review_comments: upgrade handler: solvency uses total liabilities including the acting player's own balance, so a single whale's balance can block cheap upgrades for everyone (observed: raising one test user's balance above headroom made even the 88-price target refused). Consider excluding the debited bet / using a liability model that nets out the current stake, or document this as intended conservatism.

forced_loss / forced_reason and the losing_roll() fallback remain in the code path only as a race guard; keep in mind admin 'Принудительных сливов' counter will still increment on lock-acquire failure (forced_reason='lock'), which is a payout denial that fails the 'no cancelled wins' promise if the Mongo lease ever times out — worth alerting/logging on it.
seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo users qa_fair_main, qa_solvency, qa_ui_user (all deleted, along with their upgrades/drops/presence/item_history). Bank balance never modified (42000), rtp_target restored to 0.9.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests/test_iteration12.py with -n 0 (xdist loadscope would run TestAdmin's RTP 0.85 change concurrently with the 300-spin fairness test and break it). Solvency test computes balance = headroom - 200 so that a 1580 prize is refused while an 88 prize is allowed; using headroom + 3000 (as originally suggested) makes headroom negative and refuses even the cheap target.
